title: Public Service Commission
description: Understanding Nepal's Public Service Commission, its role in civil service recruitment, and administrative functions.

sections.title: Mandate and Independence
sections.content: The Public Service Commission (PSC) oversees merit-based recruitment, ensuring neutrality and competence in the civil service. Constitutional provisions protect its autonomy from political interference.

sections.title: Recruitment Process
sections.content: Open competition, examinations, interviews, and assessments evaluate qualifications. Transparency measures include published syllabi, exam schedules, and results protocols.

sections.title: Capacity Building and Reform
sections.content: Modernization efforts integrate digital applications, competency frameworks, and diversity strategies to strengthen public administration responsiveness.

sections.title: Challenges and Future Directions
sections.content: Challenges include exam backlog, regional access disparities, and adapting to emerging skill needs. Strategic planning and technology adoption aim to address bottlenecks.

sections.title: Historical Evolution
sections.content: Recruitment shifted from patronage tendencies toward formalized merit systems, with successive reforms adding anonymized scripts, structured interview rubrics, and appeal channels.

sections.title: Technology and Innovation
sections.content: Candidate portals, remote testing pilots, item bank analytics, and biometric verification aim to improve fairness, accessibility, and integrity of examinations.

sections.title: Diversity and Inclusion Strategies
sections.content: Targeted outreach, language accommodations, and preparatory materials for underrepresented groups support a representative civil service cadre.

sections.title: Case Study: Digital Application Rollout
sections.content: Deployment of an online application reduced processing time and error rates while expanding rural applicant participation through simplified document submission.

sections.title: Future Outlook
sections.content: Advanced psychometrics, AI‑assisted screening with transparency safeguards, continuous competency mapping, and broader accessibility enhancements are emerging priorities.

summary: Historical reforms reduced patronage and added appeals
Technology drives fairness, speed, and integrity
Backlogs & regional access shape modernization agenda
Case rollout shows digital platforms boost inclusion
Continuous competency mapping guides workforce planning
